Use this page only to reproduce the historical Circular Pad Uniform-port study. It records SCGSim `1.1.0rc1`, the OrPen SC PDK producer used for execution, and a specific Palace fork; keep this study in its own project environment.

## Select the source and PDK revisions

The linked [`palace_eigenmode.qmd`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/ecc90623b62e55f95afaa5a1f1048a71f81cae52/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/CircularPad/palace_eigenmode.qmd) and its [derived notebook](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/ecc90623b62e55f95afaa5a1f1048a71f81cae52/notebooks/ComponentSimulation/CircularPad/palace_eigenmode.ipynb) are the later PDK teaching and presentation revision `ecc90623b62e55f95afaa5a1f1048a71f81cae52`, not the producer used to execute Fresh08. The [evidence README](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/ecc90623b62e55f95afaa5a1f1048a71f81cae52/notebooks/ComponentSimulation/CircularPad/evidence/README.md) identifies the executed OrPen producer as [`c79b91ef882079d937fce20129f3cbd477e8438d`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/c79b91ef882079d937fce20129f3cbd477e8438d).

The sealed run's SCGSim runtime was revision [`2eed1eb4a9bcc7b1b020feb4953d5ed27e7d7b71`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim/tree/2eed1eb4a9bcc7b1b020feb4953d5ed27e7d7b71) (`1.1.0rc1`), which contains the curved-source APIs absent from stable `1.0.2`. Create a separate project for those exact producer and runtime revisions:

```bash
uv init --python 3.12 curved-source-study
cd curved-source-study
uv add 'scgsim[palace,visualization] @ git+https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim.git@2eed1eb4a9bcc7b1b020feb4953d5ed27e7d7b71' \
  'orpen-sc-pdk @ git+https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk.git@c79b91ef882079d937fce20129f3cbd477e8438d' \
  ipykernel
```

Check: `uv run python -c "from importlib.metadata import version; print(version('scgsim'))"` prints `1.1.0rc1`.

## Native Palace for this curved Uniform port {#native-palace-for-this-curved-uniform-port}

The study records Palace fork revision [`4e9e1b7232b4c8ca8b964be7e70f1848f578de37`](https://github.com/arfiligol/palace/tree/4e9e1b7232b4c8ca8b964be7e70f1848f578de37), or a descendant containing its [curved-port extent correction](https://github.com/arfiligol/palace/blob/4e9e1b7232b4c8ca8b964be7e70f1848f578de37/palace/utils/geodata_impl.cpp). The Python package does not install native Palace. Reproduce the recorded run with its Palace MPI wrapper as the configured executable.

The notebook's default `analyze_handoff` action reads a retained `.artifacts` run tree that is not included with the source and figures. To prepare or run a new calculation, select `prepare_handoff` or `run` in the notebook and choose a fresh run ID.

The published Fresh08 run record reports mode 1 at `5.573354161115 GHz` after four refinements and five solve/estimate snapshots. Its final native indicator is `0.1186681863426` against a configured `0.02`, and its native log records PCG warnings.
